sources.q10: Derived from respiration rates, USDA Agriculture Handbook 66 or cited study (https://www.ars.usda.gov/arsuserfiles/oc/np/commercialstorage/commercialstorage.pdf)

sources.water_l_per_kg: Mekonnen and Hoekstra 2010, Report 47, global average, row 'Chillies and peppers, green', https://www.waterfootprint.org/resources/Report47-WaterFootprintCrops-Vol1.pdf
